payload.title: Rapid Mobilization — units moved to base

payload.note: StartOfRefresh objectives are checked at the start of Refresh — before retrieve, draw missions, advance-time, recruit/build, and deploy. If you satisfy the condition only after deploys (e.g. fresh units landed in Rebel-loyalty systems), the objective stays in hand and will be re-checked at the next Refresh.

pendingNotices.title: Rapid Mobilization — units moved to base
pendingNotices.details: The Rebel player moved 1 unit from Ryloth into the hidden Rebel Base. The base itself did NOT move — Rapid Mobilization's other option (establish a new base) was not used, so no probe card changes hands and Ryloth remains a possible base location.
